services.name: Mobile App Development
services.tagline: Native Android & iOS Apps That Users Love
services.description: Native Android & iOS apps with AI-powered features like smart recommendations, voice recognition, and predictive analytics for enhanced user experiences.
services.long_description: We design and build mobile apps that people actually keep on their phones. From the first wireframe to the app-store listing, our team handles UI/UX design, development, testing, and launch — then stays with you for updates and growth. Every app we ship is built for speed, offline resilience, and the small screen habits of real users. And because AI is in our DNA, your app can include smart recommendations, voice input in local languages, chat assistants, and analytics that tell you what users do next — not just what they did.
deliverables: UI/UX design with clickable prototype before coding starts
Native or cross-platform build (Flutter / React Native / Swift / Kotlin)
Backend APIs, admin panel and push notifications
AI features: recommendations, chat, voice, image recognition
Play Store and App Store publishing, ASO included
90-day post-launch support and crash monitoring

benefits.title: Fast Without Feeling Rushed
benefits.text: A working prototype in the first two weeks, then weekly builds you can install and test. You always see progress on your own phone.

benefits.title: AI Features Built In
benefits.text: Recommendations, voice input in English and Tamil, smart search, and chat assistants come from our ready AI toolkit - not a research project.

benefits.title: Works on Real Networks
benefits.text: Apps are engineered for patchy 4G and budget phones - offline caching, small download size, and battery-friendly sync.

benefits.title: A Partner After Launch
benefits.text: Launch is the start. We monitor crashes, ship updates, and iterate on user feedback with a clear monthly plan.

process.title: Discovery & Scope
process.text: We map your users, features, and success metrics in a working session, then fix scope, timeline, and price - in writing.

process.title: Design & Prototype
process.text: Wireframes become a clickable prototype you can put in front of real users before a line of code is written.

process.title: Build in Sprints
process.text: Weekly sprint builds land on your phone via TestFlight / internal testing, with a demo call every Friday.

process.title: Test & Harden
process.text: Automated and manual QA across devices, plus performance, security, and offline testing.

process.title: Launch & Grow
process.text: Store publishing, analytics dashboards, and a 90-day support runway - then ongoing iteration as your users grow.

faq.q: Native or cross-platform - which should we choose?
faq.a: For most business apps, Flutter or React Native gives you both platforms from one codebase at roughly 60% of the cost. We recommend native Swift/Kotlin when you need heavy device features like AR, advanced camera work, or platform-specific performance.

faq.q: How much does an app cost?
faq.a: A focused MVP typically starts around a fixed scope we agree upfront; complex platforms are phased so you invest as milestones prove out. Every quote is fixed-price with a written scope - no hourly surprises.

faq.q: Who owns the code and the accounts?
faq.a: You do - completely. Code lives in your repository, and the app is published on your own Play Store and App Store accounts from day one.

services.name: Web Applications
services.description: Responsive, scalable web applications with AI chatbots, automated workflows, and intelligent data processing for modern businesses.
services.long_description: From customer portals and booking systems to full SaaS products, we build web applications that stay fast at 10 users and at 100,000. Our stack pairs Laravel and Node.js backends with React and Vue frontends, deployed on infrastructure that scales automatically. Workflows that your team does by hand today - approvals, reports, follow-ups, reconciliation - become automated pipelines, and an AI layer can answer customer questions, extract data from documents, and surface insights from your database in plain English.
deliverables: Full-stack web application with responsive UI
Role-based dashboards and admin panels
Workflow automation for approvals, reports and alerts
AI chatbot and document-processing integration
REST / GraphQL APIs with documentation
Cloud deployment with CI/CD, backups and monitoring

benefits.title: Built to Scale From Day One
benefits.text: Queue workers, caching, and auto-scaling infrastructure mean growth is a pricing question, not a rewrite.

benefits.title: Automation That Pays Rent
benefits.text: We hunt the manual work in your process - approvals, reports, reminders - and turn it into workflows that run themselves.

benefits.title: Security as Standard
benefits.text: Role-based access, audit logs, encrypted data, and OWASP-hardened code on every project - not as a paid extra.

benefits.title: Plays Well With Your Stack
benefits.text: Tally, Zoho, SAP, payment gateways, WhatsApp - we integrate with the systems you already run.

process.title: Process Mapping
process.text: We sit with your team and map how work actually flows today - the spreadsheet handoffs, the WhatsApp approvals, all of it.

process.title: Design the System
process.text: Screens and data models designed around your process, reviewed with the people who will use them daily.

process.title: Build in Sprints
process.text: A staging site updates every week; your team clicks through real features and steers the roadmap.

process.title: Migrate & Train
process.text: We move your existing data in, run parallel for a safe period, and train every user role.

process.title: Operate & Improve
process.text: Monitoring, backups, and a monthly improvement cycle keep the platform sharp as your business changes.

faq.q: Can you rebuild or modernise our existing system?
faq.a: Yes - about half our projects are modernisations. We migrate your data, keep the old system running in parallel, and switch over module by module so business never stops.
We set up cloud hosting in your own account (AWS, DigitalOcean, or Indian providers), with automated backups and monitoring. Maintenance plans cover updates, security patches, and support SLAs.

faq.q: How do you handle our data during development?
faq.a: Development runs on anonymised or sample data, production access is restricted and logged, and we sign NDAs before the first conversation about your process.

services.name: E-commerce Platforms
services.description: Smart e-commerce solutions with AI-driven product recommendations, dynamic pricing, fraud detection, and personalized shopping experiences.
services.long_description: We build online stores that do more than list products - they sell. Whether it is a custom D2C storefront, a multi-vendor marketplace, or a B2B ordering portal, we engineer the full funnel: fast mobile-first pages, frictionless UPI checkout, automated GST invoicing, courier integration, and the AI layer that big marketplaces use - personalised recommendations, abandoned-cart recovery on WhatsApp, and dynamic bundling. Already on Shopify or WooCommerce? We extend, optimise, and migrate without losing a single order.
deliverables: Custom storefront or Shopify / WooCommerce build
UPI, card, wallet and COD payment integration
GST invoicing, inventory and courier integration
AI recommendations and WhatsApp cart recovery
Marketplace features: vendors, commissions, payouts
SEO, analytics and conversion tracking setup

benefits.title: Mobile-First, Because India Shops on Phones
benefits.text: 90% of your traffic will be mobile. Every page is designed thumb-first and loads in under two seconds on 4G.

benefits.title: WhatsApp Is Your Second Storefront
benefits.text: Order updates, cart recovery, and catalogue sharing on the app your customers open 50 times a day.

benefits.title: Amazon-Grade AI, Your Store
benefits.text: Personalised recommendations, smart search, and dynamic bundles lift average order value on autopilot.

benefits.title: Compliance on Autopilot
benefits.text: GST invoices, courier manifests, COD reconciliation, and returns handled by the system, not your late nights.

process.title: Store Strategy
process.text: Products, pricing, logistics, and platform choice (custom vs Shopify vs WooCommerce) decided with real numbers.

process.title: Design for Conversion
process.text: Storefront designed around your catalogue and buyer behaviour - home, category, product, and checkout flows.

process.title: Build & Integrate
process.text: Payments, shipping, GST, and inventory wired in; AI recommendation and recovery flows configured.

process.title: Load & Launch
process.text: Bulk catalogue import, test orders end-to-end, then go live with tracking pixels and analytics in place.

process.title: Optimise Relentlessly
process.text: Monthly CRO cycle: heatmaps, funnel analysis, A/B tests - because launch-day conversion is never the ceiling.

faq.q: Custom store or Shopify - what do you recommend?
faq.a: Shopify/WooCommerce gets you live fastest and fits most D2C brands. Go custom when you need marketplace features, B2B pricing logic, deep ERP integration, or want zero platform fees at scale. We build both and will show you the honest math.

faq.q: Can you migrate our existing store without losing orders or SEO?
faq.a: Yes - products, customers, order history, and URL redirects are all migrated. Your search rankings are protected with a redirect map and we run both stores in parallel during cutover.
Yes, we can make your catalogue ONDC-ready so you sell through the open network alongside your own store.

services.name: HRMS Solutions
services.description: Intelligent HR management systems with AI-powered recruitment, performance analytics, employee insights, and automated workflows.
services.long_description: We implement HR systems that take the spreadsheet out of people management. Attendance from geo-fenced mobile punches or your biometric devices flows straight into payroll with PF, ESI, and TDS computed correctly every month. Recruitment gets an AI assistant that screens hundreds of resumes in minutes. Employees get a self-service app for leave, payslips, and reimbursements - and HR gets their week back. We deploy our PeopleCore platform configured to your policies, or build fully custom when your rules demand it.
deliverables: Attendance: geo-fenced mobile, biometric integration
Payroll automation with PF, ESI, TDS and PT compliance
Leave, shift, overtime and holiday management
AI recruitment: resume screening and candidate ranking
Employee self-service mobile app
Appraisals, onboarding and exit workflows

benefits.title: Payroll in a Morning, Not a Week
benefits.text: Attendance flows into salary runs automatically - one click computes, generates payslips, and produces the bank file.

benefits.title: Compliance Without a Consultant
benefits.text: PF, ESI, TDS, and professional tax rules are built in and kept current - audits stop being scary.

benefits.title: Attendance You Can Trust
benefits.text: Geo-fencing and biometric integration end proxy punches; every entry has evidence attached.

benefits.title: Hire Weeks Faster
benefits.text: AI screens the resume pile to a ranked shortlist with reasons, so good candidates hear from you first.

process.title: Policy Workshop
process.text: We document your shifts, leave rules, salary structures, and approval chains - the real ones, not the handbook version.

process.title: Configure & Integrate
process.text: System configured to your policies; biometric devices, Tally, and bank formats connected.

process.title: Pilot Run
process.text: One month of parallel payroll against your current process proves the numbers match to the rupee.

process.title: Company-Wide Rollout
process.text: Employee app rollout with training for HR, managers, and staff - in the languages your teams speak.

process.title: Support Every Cycle
process.text: We stay on call through the first payroll cycles and keep statutory rules updated as regulations change.

faq.q: We have 5 branches and biometric devices from different brands - will it work?
faq.a: Yes. We integrate all major biometric brands into one attendance stream, and multi-branch, multi-shift setups are standard configuration, not custom work.

faq.q: How do you guarantee payroll accuracy during switchover?
faq.a: We run at least one full parallel cycle: your old process and the new system compute the same month, and we reconcile to the rupee before you switch.

faq.q: Can employees without smartphones use it?
faq.a: Yes - biometric or kiosk punch-in covers non-smartphone staff, and HR can manage their leave and payslips on their behalf.

services.name: CRM Systems
services.description: AI-enhanced customer relationship management with predictive lead scoring, automated follow-ups, and intelligent sales forecasting.
services.long_description: Leads leak when they live in personal phones and memory. We implement CRM systems that capture every enquiry from your website, WhatsApp, ads, and walk-ins into one pipeline - then make sure every one gets followed up. AI scores each lead so your team calls the hottest first, automated sequences nurture the rest, and owners get forecasts based on behaviour rather than optimism. We deploy our KA CRM platform tailored to your sales process, extend Salesforce/Zoho, or build custom when your workflow demands it.
deliverables: Lead capture from website, ads, WhatsApp and calls
Custom pipeline stages matching your sales process
AI lead scoring and deal-win prediction
Automated follow-up sequences and reminders
WhatsApp Business API and email integration
Dashboards, forecasting and team performance reports

benefits.title: Every Lead Captured
benefits.text: Website forms, Meta ads, WhatsApp, missed calls - every enquiry lands in the pipeline automatically with source tracking.

benefits.title: Call the Right Lead First
benefits.text: AI scoring ranks prospects by real buying signals, so your team's first hour goes to the leads most likely to close.

benefits.title: Follow-ups That Never Slip
benefits.text: Automated sequences and reminders mean the lead from last month still gets its call - without anyone remembering.

benefits.title: Forecasts Owners Can Bank On
benefits.text: Pipeline analytics show what will close this month and where deals die - so you fix the funnel, not blame the team.

process.title: Sales Process Audit
process.text: We shadow how leads actually flow today and find where they leak - usually within the first meeting.

process.title: Pipeline Design
process.text: Stages, fields, scoring rules, and automations designed around how your team really sells.

process.title: Connect Every Source
process.text: Website, Meta/Google ads, WhatsApp API, and telephony wired into the pipeline with source attribution.

process.title: Team Onboarding
process.text: Hands-on training with your live leads - reps see their day get easier, which is what makes CRM stick.

process.title: Review & Tune
process.text: Monthly reviews of conversion by stage and source; scoring and automations tuned as data accumulates.

faq.q: Our sales team hates data entry - how will this be different?
faq.a: Most data enters itself: leads auto-capture from every source, WhatsApp chats log automatically, and mobile voice notes replace typing. Reps use it because it hands them a ranked call list, not homework.

faq.q: Should we buy Salesforce/Zoho or build custom?
faq.a: If a standard tool fits your process, we implement and customise it honestly. Custom makes sense when licensing costs at your team size exceed build cost, or your workflow just does not fit the mould. We will show you both numbers.

faq.q: Can it integrate with our existing telephony or IVR?
faq.a: Yes - calls log against leads with recordings, and missed calls auto-create follow-up tasks. We support all major Indian cloud telephony providers.

services.name: AI/ML Solutions
services.tagline: Custom AI That Solves Real Business Problems
services.description: Custom artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions including computer vision, NLP, predictive analytics, and automation.
services.long_description: AI creates value when it is aimed at a specific, measurable business problem - not adopted for the press release. We build custom AI systems that inspect products on your line, read your documents, answer your customers, forecast your demand, and automate your workflows. Our team works across computer vision, natural language processing, predictive modelling, and LLM-powered agents, and we are blunt about one thing: if a simpler solution beats AI for your problem, we will tell you before you spend.
deliverables: Computer vision: defect detection, safety, OCR
NLP: chatbots, document AI, voice agents
Predictive models: demand, churn, credit, pricing
LLM agents and RAG systems on your private data
MLOps: deployment, monitoring and retraining pipelines
AI strategy audit and feasibility proof-of-concept

benefits.title: Business Metric First
benefits.text: Every engagement starts with the number you want to move - rejection rate, response time, forecast error - and is judged against it.

benefits.title: Prove It Small, Then Scale
benefits.text: A 4-6 week pilot on your real data shows accuracy and ROI before you commit to production budgets.

benefits.title: Your Data Stays Yours
benefits.text: On-premise and private-cloud deployment options mean sensitive data never leaves your infrastructure.

benefits.title: Production, Not Prototype
benefits.text: Monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines keep models accurate long after the demo - AI that survives contact with reality.

process.title: Problem & Data Audit
process.text: We define the metric to move and audit whether your data can move it - honestly, including when it cannot yet.

process.title: Feasibility Pilot
process.text: A focused 4-6 week proof-of-concept on your real data, with accuracy numbers you can take to the board.

process.title: Production Build
process.text: The pilot hardens into a production system with APIs, UI, and integration into your existing tools.

process.title: Deploy Your Way
process.text: Cloud, on-premise, or edge deployment with security review - whatever your data policy requires.

process.title: Monitor & Retrain
process.text: Live accuracy dashboards, drift alerts, and scheduled retraining keep the system sharp as your data evolves.

faq.q: We're not sure if our problem needs AI - can you tell us?
faq.a: Yes, and we will be honest. The audit phase exists to say 'this needs AI', 'this needs a rules engine', or 'this needs better data first'. About a third of audits end with us recommending something cheaper than AI.

faq.q: How much data do we need to get started?
faq.a: Less than you think for many problems - modern foundation models mean document AI and chatbots can start with hundreds of examples, not millions. Vision and forecasting need more; the audit tells you exactly.

faq.q: Can everything run on-premise for compliance?
faq.a: Yes - vision systems, document AI, and even LLM-based systems can run fully inside your network using open-weight models when regulations demand it.
